title: docs: fix typos in comments and documentation
description:
## Summary

Fix 4 typos in comments and one user-facing error string, across 2 files:

- **lib/bubbler/bubbler.js**: `targetting` -> `targeting` (spelled correctly as `targeting` in `lib/main.js`); the `- events` option doc read `will only fire on these events with these names` - dropped the dangling `these` so it parallels the `- types` line directly above it (`will only fire on events contained in this list`).
- **lib/main.js**: the `Invalid assembler found` error concatenated `"...must have " + " a name, and ..."`, producing a double space in the message. Removed the leading space in the continuation string.
- **lib/main.js**: the `get()` doc for the `computed` option read `If false, will not include return the unaltered object assigned to this path` - an unfinished edit. Changed to `If false, will return the unaltered object assigned to this path`, which matches `Store.get`, where `includeComputed === false` skips the computed properties and returns the stored object.

The error-string change is the only one that touches a runtime string. `test/giza.js` asserts only `.should.throw()` for that case and does not match on the message text, so no test changes are needed.

No functional changes otherwise - comments/documentation only. No identifiers were renamed.
